name: FA_MC_LEASE_SCHEDULE_ITEMS
description: This table contains all the payment types and amounts for both lease and asset level schedule.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the accounting ledger.

columns.name: LEASE_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Unique identification number for each payment type included in the lease payment schedule.

columns.name: LEASE_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Unique lease payment schedule identification number.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Serial number for the payment types included in the lease payment schedule.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Types of payments the lessee must make to the lessor as per the lease contract.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ASSETS
columns.description: Number assets to be added to the asset book for the asset lease.

columns.name: INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the first lease payment starts.

columns.name: INTEREST_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the interest on lease liability is to be calculated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount payable as per the lease contract.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_INSTALLMENTS
columns.description: Number of lease payments the lessee has to pay as per the lease contract.

columns.name: INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Incremental borrowing rate of the lessee to be used to calculate the present value of lease payments.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Number of units leased in a lease contract.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Identifies the unit of measure.

columns.name: PRICE_INDEX_ID
columns.description: Unique price index identification number.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_IN_LIABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a lease payment to be excluded in calculating the lease liability.

columns.name: INCLUDE_IN_COST_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a lease payment to be excluded in calculating the leased asset cost.

columns.name: EXPENSE_CHANGES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether any change in current period lease payment to beged to the profit and loss account.

columns.name: PURCHASE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the lessee purchase the leased asset from lessor.

columns.name: TERMINATION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the lessee terminates the lease contract.

columns.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: Date of the last lease payment.
